name: agent-room
description: Multi-agent coding chatroom: specialized agents (Dev, QA, ...) coordinate on a task via a shared live log, powered by pluggable backends (Cursor CLI by default).

agentRoom.model.description: Model passed to cursor-agent as --model (empty = Cursor's default).

agentRoom.maxRounds.description: Maximum Dev/QA rounds before giving up.

scripts.build: tsc && npm run build:ext && npm run build:desktop
scripts.build:desktop: esbuild src/desktop/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/desktop/main.cjs && esbuild src/desktop/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/desktop/preload.cjs && esbuild src/desktop/renderer.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/desktop/renderer.js && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/desktop/index.html','dist/desktop/index.html')"
